howToPlay: Otis is a Controller who deals explosive damage to tanks while using his Super to silence enemies. Use the Dormant Star or Phat Splatter gadgets to control areas, and equip Stencil Glue to extend the duration of his silencing Super.
gears: Use the Damage and Super Charge gears to maximize output and silence uptime. Equip Speed or Health gears to better navigate the map and improve survivability given his 3600 health.
trait: This brawler suits players who prefer disrupting enemy tactics and controlling space through precise crowd control.
